05/08：同一导航条的镜片选区移动到Search，搜索图标和文字变蓝，其他项保持原位置。
05/08：选区抵达右侧Profile，蓝色图标与文字在运动中有残影，导航条外壳与四项保持。
05/08：选区从右侧回到Activity，活动图标与文字蓝色，透明胶囊在第三项附近。

07/08：同一三行结果保持，第二行Liquid ideas为蓝色高亮，底部向上键；查询liquid与蓝色插入光标保持。
07/08：高亮回到第一行，底部Return键；框与内容开始收拢、退场，文字及第三行存在运动模糊。
07/08到08/08过渡：三条玻璃通知开始叠放，中间Music/Glass Hearts已出现，下方Liquid Glass/Render complete仍在，上方空玻璃条正形成下一条；不是静态切换三卡。
08/08：三条通知稳定叠放。顶部FITNESS/Goal reached/10,000 steps before noon；中间MUSIC/Glass Hearts/Nova Bloom—now playing；下方LIQUID GLASS/Render complete/960 frames at60fps in3.2s。各条右上now。

differences: Square1440×1440 is independently reflowed into1920×1080; central glass controls enlarged for horizontal reading and safe-area labels. Whole36-second preset retains all eight groups, then typography/lens tail.

Chinese titles, query, app names and control labels are independent replacements; source uses English. Header uses title parameter. Original source complete final tagline was not legible; 为流动而设计 is original wording.
Reference blur field is rebuilt with local CSS gradients. Icons, album artwork, application marks and fitness rings are original SVG/CSS drawings, not downloaded source imagery.

No mouse was observed in the source. Simulated cursor, click rings and explicit drag trajectories were added to provide operation causality; they are original choreography, not proof of source clicks.
Source share icon remains unchanged; reconstruction adds no share completion, upload or external business result.

Actual local refraction is approximated by a duplicated persistent text layer, ellipse clipping following --lens-x, and a fixed-seed SVG displacement filter. This is not a physically exact refractive shader. Backdrop blur/highlight layers also differ.
Text transition timing, circle-to-strip expansion, inter-section blur/scale and glass strip-to-player morph are independently retimed/reconstructed; exact original morph geometry is not claimed.

Seven chart values are explicit invented example values5800/7100/5600/8500/11000/10200/10000, summing58200. Source exact values/final total were not fully legible. Source sampled total58,180 was a rolling intermediate value.
Source flashlight yellow sampled state still readOff. Reconstruction synchronizes yellow with Chinese 开启 as an explicit consistency adaptation, not a source transcription.

Notifications retain fitness/music/rendering order and identities, but text is Chinese; rendering960frames/60fps and fitness10,000steps are marked example results and do not assert real execution or this new preset export performance.
No section-only builder parameter was implemented. sectionRanges metadata describes editable extraction time spans; the registered preset remains the full36-second suite.
